steps.content: Hella sprints for her life through the tunnel.
The sounds of her pursuer echo from all directions—sometimes near, sometimes far—like a cat toying with a cornered mouse, savoring the chase.
Again, she twists aside just in time, narrowly avoiding another strike. This time, she hears it—a breathy, exhilarated laugh, ringing from the shadows.
Heh... I did warn you not to come out after dark. Now why didn't you listen, hm?
Hella recognizes that mocking laughter. She whips her head around and finally catches a glimpse of her pursuer's face—
The figure steps forward, unhurried, as if emerging from the darkness itself.

Monsters prowl at her side, their growls rumbling like distant thunder. Heavy Aurum Secretum chains coil around their necks, clenched tightly in Synex's grip as she urges them forward, herding Hella toward a dead end.
Amid the beasts, Synex stands, as if she were always one of them.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Oh darling, I did warn you about the "dangerous things underground." But you just had to ignore me, didn't you?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Such a shame... I liked you. Really, I did. I was even hoping to keep you around, just a little more fun before the end. But no... you didn't give me a choice.
Before the last word even leaves her lips, her wrist flicks. Chains snap taut, and the monsters surge forward with ear-splitting howls.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Come, say hello to my dear brothers and sisters.
